note: Apply via references/tools.md procedure. Hits are prompts to read unless the skill method says otherwise.

extract_numbers.purpose: List every number in a text with its context, for matching against the source.
procedure: For each line, find all number_regex matches.
Classify kind from unit (pp/percentage points; %/percent; patients→count; other unit→quantity; bare decimal <10→ratio-like or decimal; else number).
Emit line, number as written, kind, surrounding text.
Also list units that appear with more than one distinct value.

risk_metrics.purpose: Absolute and relative effects for a binary outcome, from supplied arm values.
